It is covered by the occlusion and target audits at 375 and 320 in both shells, but it does override superseded style.css geometry and should be re-checked when Todo 18 re-authors that layer.
Reduced motion is now enforced by ONE unscoped rule in caret-shell.css. Todo 18 re-authors that file and must carry the rule forward or reduced motion regresses silently in both shells.
--cf-target-min was added to caret-foundation.css and is consumed by caret-operator.css. Todo 18's layer replacement must preserve the token, not just the rules that read it.

The native announcement commit lives in MinibarProjection.render(...). Any future caller that uses view(...) to drive a real render will reintroduce per-tick announcements; view(...) is documented as pure and non-committing for exactly this reason.
